1395-1849-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-2158-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-2158-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2773-4694-7839--112.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
2773-4694-7839--112.description:
Deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
When the Treasure(s) enter as creature(s) due to March of the Machines, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.
2773-4694-7839--112.notes: The anthem effect must boost the power and toughness of artifact creatures you control by 1 or more. While you will get infinite Treasures, because they are creatures, you cannot activate them right away unless you give them haste. If the anthem increases power by 2 or more, you can get additional Warstorm Surge triggers to deal infinite damage.

215-2026-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2026-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Voyaging Satyr any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2178-4050-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-4050-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-4050-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

1368-3755-4068-6321.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-3755-4068-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2103-4477-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and exiling Ephemerate.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5295-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

628-3698-7219.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Reaper trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

141-780-2511.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

141-554-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-2292.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1781-1978-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1781-1978-3443.description:
Cause Deathbloom Ritualist to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-2921-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3769-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
3769-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1680-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2

2523-5297-5686.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

222-527-955-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

275-2034-2279-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
275-2034-2279-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2770-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites: Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
2770-6085-6086-6087.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2089-2351-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
2089-2351-5231.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability riggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Symmetry Matrix triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {R}.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

344-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
344-3489-3542.description:
Declare Skullsnatcher as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

250-779-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, creature or land.
Repeat.

2757-2800-5285.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic Plains.
You are the monarch.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
2757-2800-5285.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping a basic Plains.
Repeat.

225-539-3467.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-539-3467.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, targeting itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2397-4022-4499.description:
Pay {3} to activate Emiel, exiling and returning Hidden Herablist to the battlefield.
Hidden Herbalist triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3492-3609-5006.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-5006.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coretapper from your graveyard using Lurrus of the Dream-Den's ability by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.
